newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar hovers in range, nearbys focus.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar hovers in range, nearbys focus.

text.p: White sugar futures mostly opted to stay within the day's tight trading ranges as the nearby December/March spread continued as the centre of market attention, traders said on Wednesday. Ranges were no more than $1.90 on any position and business was routine with no dominant feature to the listless session. "There was a little bounce in the market but it's backed down, the volume's awful," said one trader. Some broker selling of the key March contract was reported, possibly against the Paris market, along with commission house buying of the Dec/March spread.
"It's generally been pretty quiet, there's been a bit of buying in the Dec/March," the trader said.

At 1650 GMT December was 40 cents lower at $313.80 and March 90 cents down at $309.50. Volume reached a modest 1,672 lots. Technically, December and March are still moving downwards within a channel dating from reaction lows on September 17, despite the recent slight firmness.
Analysts pegged December's support at $310 after the contract broke through the previous $315 support level earlier this week. This would now provide strong resistance, they said.
Paris trading was confined to the two nearby positions in an overall volume of 1,349 lots.
December was 70 cents lower at $312.80 and March down 50 cents at $309.80.
